prompt: Write RosterSnapshot so private does not leak: copy the list and array on the way in and hand back copies on the way out. Complete the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: A private field that holds a reference to someone else's mutable object is not really private -- the caller still has the reference and can change what you hold. Copying on the way in (a defensive copy in the constructor) and again on the way out (in each getter) is what makes the snapshot genuinely immutable. Note that the array copy has to be element by element or via Arrays.copyOf, because assigning an array variable only copies the reference.
hints: In the constructor build a new ArrayList and addAll the incoming names instead of storing the caller's list.
Arrays are objects too: copy the int[] into a fresh array of the same length rather than storing the argument.
getNames and getScores must build a new copy every call, otherwise the caller can still reach into the snapshot.
